Combat Core

Combat Core

Combat is divided into Rounds and Turns.

A Round is one full cycle in which every combatant gets one Turn.

A Turn is one combatant’s moment to act.

Initiative is rolled once at the start of combat.

Initiative Order is established at the start of each Round and remains fixed for that Round. Initiative is not rolled again at the start of each Round unless a rule explicitly allows it.

Dice Basics

All dice rolled in the Mastery System use d8s.

When a die rolls an 8, it explodes:

  • roll that die again,
  • add the new result to the 8,
  • if the new roll is also an 8, repeat.

Damage dice do not explode unless a rule explicitly says otherwise.

Dice Pools

Most rolls use the format: XkY

This means:

  • roll X dice,
  • keep the best Y dice,
  • add the kept dice together.

For most tests:

  • Pool = relevant Attribute
  • Keep = Mastery Rank

Example:

A character with Might 8 and Mastery Rank 3 rolls: 8k3

They roll 8 dice and keep the best 3.

Pool and Keep

Roll the final dice Pool after all reductions. Mastery Rank defines the maximum number of dice kept; it does not raise the number of dice rolled.

Effective Keep = min(Mastery Rank, final Pool). A final Pool of 0 dice fails automatically.

Example: A character with Resolve 2 and Mastery Rank 4 rolls 2d8 and keeps both (2k2). If a later effect removes both dice, the resulting 0k0 check fails.

Mastery Rank Keep
